grh_55da48e197288ecb575f.title: Hand of Glory
paragraphs: Trying to lie low in rural England, Harry accepts an invitation from Helen to stay with her twin uncles, retired scientists obsessed with discovering the secret of making gold. Their laboratory research turns out to include an occult recipe for a 'hand of glory' requiring material from a murdered stranger and a hanged man. Harry realizes the uncles intend to kill a wandering tramp and then murder Harry so the two bodies will supply what they need. The plan collapses before Harry can become their victim, leaving the uncles themselves dead in the laboratory. A newly discovered will leaves their fortune to Helen rather than their gold-making foundation, and Helen chooses to remain with her inheritance instead of leaving with penniless Harry.

grh_55776a90c774bbc26037.title: Earl on Troubled Waters
paragraphs: Harry joins Robinson in a scheme to move a large sum of money across the Channel and winds up carrying £29,000 while a troublesome boy named Ronald keeps noticing more than Harry would like. Harry takes control of the cash and leaves Ronald guarding Robinson, hoping to slip ashore with the money. Instead, Ronald brings officials and proudly identifies both the smuggler and Harry as the man who stopped him. Harry instantly recasts himself as an anti-smuggling hero, turns over £5,000 as the recovered money and quietly keeps the other £24,000 hidden in his billfold. Ronald gets the praise while Harry gets the profit the boy never knew existed.
